分析流程与参数

从专题 README 抽取；原文顺序保留，未跑过的部分照实标注。

蒸馏日期: 2026-10-28

分析范式: 10x Visium spot 级反卷积 / cell2location
可信度评级: 中高 —— 原始流程完整，但本机只做了缩减规模的 CPU smoke test；未做完整 73,260 cells / 30,000 epochs 复现

2. 分析流程 🔶

流程图源码（Mermaid）
flowchart LR
    A[10x Visium h5 + spatial/] --> B[read_visium]
    B --> C[去除 MT 基因]
    C --> D[spot 子集]
    E[scRNA reference h5ad] --> F[GeneID/SYMBOL 对齐]
    F --> G[filter_genes very-permissive]
    G --> H[RegressionModel: 估计 cell-type signatures]
    D --> I[共享基因交集]

    J --> K[export_posterior: q05/mean abundance]
    K --> L[QC + 空间丰度图]
详细步骤
步骤 输入 工具 输出 状态
1. 下载 10x Visium、Sanger scRNA curl h5 + spatial + sc.h5ad ✅
2. 读入 Visium h5 + spatial/ scanpy.read_visium spot × gene AnnData ✅
3. 去 MT Visium AnnData Scanpy/布尔掩码 去 MT 的 AnnData + obsm["MT"] ✅
4. 参考过滤 scRNA AnnData cell2location.filter_genes 10,237 → 5,000 genes（本机 smoke） ✅
5. 参考下采样 73,260 cells 分层随机抽样 5,754 cells / 34 types ✅
6. 训练 reference scRNA 子集 RegressionModel cell-type signature ✅
7. 空间映射 Visium 子集 + signature Cell2location spot × cell-type abundance ✅
8. 导出与可视化 posterior q05_cell_abundance_w_sf + matplotlib PDF + TSV ✅

5. 关键参数 🔶

参数 原文/官方教程 本机 smoke test 说明
N_cells_per_location 30 30 每个 spot 的预期细胞数；应由配对 H&E、分割或 Loupe 估计，不是固定真理
detection_alpha 20（人） 20 技术检测噪声先验；文章建议小鼠可用 200，最好做敏感性分析
cell_count_cutoff 5 5 filter_genes 的 very-permissive 过滤
cell_percentage_cutoff2 0.03 0.03 保留罕见 marker 的宽松阈值
nonz_mean_cutoff 1.12 1.12 非零均值阈值
reference max_epochs 250 20 CPU smoke 不能替代收敛训练
spatial max_epochs 30,000 50 原文是完整映射；本机只验证流程可跑
reference posterior samples 1,000 50 本机缩减
spatial posterior samples 1,000 20 本机缩减
reference cells 73,260 5,754 每个 Subset 最多 200 cells
spatial spots 4,039 1,000 随机种子 0
genes 10,237 5,000 取参考与空间共享基因中表达细胞数最高的 5,000 个

🔶 max_genes=5000 是本机为 CPU smoke test 加的；官方流程不做这个截断。它可能改变 signature 和丰度，不能用于生物学结论。

8. 注意事项 🔶

  • 原始计数: Cell2location 期望非负计数；不要把已经 log-normalize 的矩阵直接喂入。文章参考 sc.h5ad 的 X 是 counts（本机抽查最大值 28）。
  • 基因 ID 对齐: Visium 和参考都改用 Ensembl ID，避免 symbol 重复；本机去 MT 后保留 5,000 个共享基因。
  • MT 基因: 文章建议先从 Visium 去掉 MT；本机移除了 13 个 MT 基因，并把它们的表达保存到 obsm["MT"]。
  • N_cells_per_location: 30 是文章示例，不应无条件套到所有组织；最好用配对组织学/分割估计并做敏感性分析。
  • detection_alpha: 人组织 20、 小鼠 200 是文章建议；本机只跑 20，未做 20 vs 200 对比。
  • 训练轮数: 20/50 epochs 只是“能跑通”，不能说明模型已收敛；完整教程是 250/30,000。
  • 下采样: 每类最多 200 cells、5,000 genes、1,000 spots 都会改变结果；不要用本机输出做生物学结论。
  • CPU: 本机无 GPU；cell2location_cpu 的 torch 是 CPU 版。完整数据全量训练预计需要显著更长时间。
  • 用户级包污染: 运行前设置 PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1，否则 ~/.local 的 transformers/httpx 可能覆盖 env 依赖。
  • 输出格式: 本专题所有结果图只写 PDF；图册构建器再把 PDF 栅格化成网页预览 PNG，源 PDF 仍是可复现矢量。

本机实跑记录

运行命令：

cd ~/hz_代码教程/06_空转/01_Visium/1.2_Cell2location反卷积
PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 bash run_smoke_test.sh

本机实际结果：

  • reference：5,754 cells × 5,000 genes，34 cell types，20 epochs，470.6 秒
  • spatial：1,000 spots × 5,000 genes，34 cell types，50 epochs，387.3 秒
  • posterior：reference 50 samples；spatial 20 samples
  • 产物：3 个 PDF、3 个 summary TSV、signature TSV、top abundance TSV
  • 运行环境：CPU，无 GPU；cell2location 0.1.5、scvi-tools 1.3.3、torch 2.3.0+cpu

复现边界：这是一次“流程可跑 + 输出可读”的缩减 smoke test，不是论文级全量复现，也没有对细胞类型空间分布做生物学结论。要做正式分析，至少需要恢复全量参考/spot、提高 epochs、增加 posterior samples，并做 N_cells_per_location / detection_alpha 敏感性分析。

展开其余 7 个章节（工具栈、数据格式、可视化方法、参考文献等）

1. 生物学问题 ✅

用带细胞类型注释的单细胞 RNA-seq 作为参考，估计 Visium 每个 spot 内不同细胞类型的丰度，从“组织切片上的表达”推进到“细胞类型空间分布”。

  • 组织/模型: 人淋巴结；10x Genomics V1_Human_Lymph_Node Visium
  • 参考数据: 整合淋巴结、脾脏、扁桃体的 scRNA-seq，73,260 cells、34 个 Subset 细胞类型
  • 实验设计: 参考 scRNA + Visium spot 矩阵；不是两组差异设计
  • 核心假设: 参考数据覆盖目标组织中可能出现的细胞状态；spot 的表达可以分解为细胞类型 signature 与丰度的组合
  • 不能直接回答: 细胞类型在某个 spot 的“真实数量”、细胞间通讯、因果调控或疾病组间差异

6. 代码片段

完整可运行代码在 scripts/，不要只复制下面片段：

  • scripts/00_download_data.sh：下载 10x Visium + Sanger 参考
  • scripts/01_prepare_tutorial_data.py：读取、去 MT、过滤、分层下采样、保存中间对象
  • scripts/02_train_reference.py：训练 RegressionModel，导出 signature
  • scripts/03_map_spatial.py：训练 Cell2location，导出 q05 丰度与 PDF
  • scripts/04_export_qc.py：从保存的模型重新生成训练曲线和 QC PDF
6.1 Visium 读入与去 MT
import scanpy as sc

adata_vis = sc.read_visium(
    data_dir,
    count_file="V1_Human_Lymph_Node_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
    load_images=True,
)
adata_vis.var_names_make_unique()
adata_vis.obs["sample"] = "V1_Human_Lymph_Node"
adata_vis.var["SYMBOL"] = adata_vis.var_names
adata_vis.var.set_index("gene_ids", drop=True, inplace=True)

mt = adata_vis.var["SYMBOL"].astype(str).str.startswith(("MT-", "MT."))
adata_vis.obsm["MT"] = adata_vis[:, mt].X.toarray()
adata_vis = adata_vis[:, ~mt].copy()
6.2 参考 signature
from cell2location.models import RegressionModel
from cell2location.utils.filtering import filter_genes

selected = filter_genes(
    adata_ref,
    cell_count_cutoff=5,
    cell_percentage_cutoff2=0.03,
    nonz_mean_cutoff=1.12,
)
adata_ref = adata_ref[:, selected].copy()

RegressionModel.setup_anndata(
    adata=adata_ref,
    batch_key="Sample",
    labels_key="Subset",
    categorical_covariate_keys=["Method"],
)
mod = RegressionModel(adata_ref)
mod.train(max_epochs=250, batch_size=2500, train_size=1, accelerator="gpu")
adata_ref = mod.export_posterior(
    adata_ref,
    sample_kwargs={"num_samples": 1000, "batch_size": 2500},
)
6.3 空间映射
import numpy as np
from cell2location.models import Cell2location

shared = np.intersect1d(adata_vis.var_names, inf_aver.index)
adata_vis = adata_vis[:, shared].copy()
inf_aver = inf_aver.loc[shared]

Cell2location.setup_anndata(adata=adata_vis, batch_key="sample")
mod = Cell2location(
    adata_vis,
    cell_state_df=inf_aver,
    N_cells_per_location=30,
    detection_alpha=20,
)
mod.train(
    max_epochs=30000,
    batch_size=None,
    train_size=1,
    accelerator="gpu",
)
adata_vis = mod.export_posterior(
    adata_vis,
    sample_kwargs={"num_samples": 1000, "batch_size": mod.adata.n_obs},
)

10. 适用场景

  • 数据兼容: 10x Visium spot 级空间转录组；需要同组织或相近组织的带注释 scRNA 参考。
  • 规模: 本机 smoke 为 5,754 cells / 1,000 spots / 5,000 genes；完整教程为 73,260 cells / 4,039 spots / 10,237 genes。
  • 前提技能: 熟悉 Scanpy/AnnData、细胞类型注释、贝叶斯模型训练和空间坐标。
  • 可迁移性: 🔶 参考组织、N_cells_per_location、detection_alpha 和基因过滤都必须按项目重设。
  • 不适用: Xenium / CosMx / CellBin 等已经是单细胞分割的平台不应做 spot 去卷积；这类平台应走细胞级空间分析。

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PYTHON_BIN="${PYTHON_BIN:-~/miniforge3/envs/cell2location_cpu/bin/python}"
export PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1
export MPLBACKEND=Agg

cd "${ROOT}"
mkdir -p results logs

echo "== 00 download =="
bash scripts/00_download_data.sh

echo "== 01 prepare =="
"${PYTHON_BIN}" scripts/01_prepare_tutorial_data.py --config config.example.yaml

echo "== 02 reference model =="
REF_EPOCHS="${REF_EPOCHS:-20}"
"${PYTHON_BIN}" scripts/02_train_reference.py \
  --config config.example.yaml \
  --max-epochs "${REF_EPOCHS}"

echo "== 03 spatial mapping =="
SP_EPOCHS="${SP_EPOCHS:-50}"
"${PYTHON_BIN}" scripts/03_map_spatial.py \
  --config config.example.yaml \
  --max-epochs "${SP_EPOCHS}"

echo "== done =="
ls -lh results/fig_cell2location_spatial.pdf results/sp.h5ad results/reference_signatures.tsv
scripts/00_download_data.sh bash · 1207 bytes 
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
DATA="${ROOT}/data"
mkdir -p "${DATA}"

download() {
  local url="$1"
  local target="$2"
  if [[ -s "${target}" ]]; then
    echo "exists: ${target}"
    return
  fi
  echo "download: ${url}"
  curl -L --retry 3 --continue-at - --output "${target}" "${url}"
}

download \
  "https://cf.10xgenomics.com/samples/spatial-exp/1.0.0/V1_Human_Lymph_Node/V1_Human_Lymph_Node_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5" \
  "${DATA}/V1_Human_Lymph_Node_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"
download \
  "https://cf.10xgenomics.com/samples/spatial-exp/1.0.0/V1_Human_Lymph_Node/V1_Human_Lymph_Node_spatial.tar.gz" \
  "${DATA}/V1_Human_Lymph_Node_spatial.tar.gz"
download \
  "https://cell2location.cog.sanger.ac.uk/paper/integrated_lymphoid_organ_scrna/RegressionNBV4Torch_57covariates_73260cells_10237genes/sc.h5ad" \
  "${DATA}/sc.h5ad"

if [[ ! -f "${DATA}/spatial/tissue_positions_list.csv" ]]; then
  tar -xzf "${DATA}/V1_Human_Lymph_Node_spatial.tar.gz" -C "${DATA}"
fi

echo "data ready:"
ls -lh \
  "${DATA}/V1_Human_Lymph_Node_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5" \
  "${DATA}/V1_Human_Lymph_Node_spatial.tar.gz" \
  "${DATA}/sc.h5ad"
scripts/01_prepare_tutorial_data.py python · 5630 bytes 
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepare the Cell2location Visium tutorial as a small CPU smoke test."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import anndata as ad
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scanpy as sc
import yaml
from cell2location.utils.filtering import filter_genes


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def load_config(path: Path) -> dict:
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return yaml.safe_load(handle)


def resolve(value: str | Path) -> Path:
    path = Path(value)
    return path if path.is_absolute() else ROOT / path


def remove_mt(adata: ad.AnnData) -> int:
    if "SYMBOL" not in adata.var:
        adata.var["SYMBOL"] = adata.var_names.astype(str)
    mt_mask = adata.var["SYMBOL"].astype(str).str.startswith(("MT-", "MT.")).to_numpy()
    if mt_mask.any():
        adata.obsm["MT"] = adata[:, mt_mask].X.toarray()
        adata = adata[:, ~mt_mask].copy()
    return int(mt_mask.sum())


def stratified_subsample(
    adata: ad.AnnData,
    label_key: str,
    max_per_label: int,
    seed: int,
) -> ad.AnnData:
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    selected: list[int] = []
    groups = adata.obs.groupby(label_key, observed=True).indices
    for indices in groups.values():
        indices = np.asarray(indices)
        n = min(max_per_label, len(indices))
        selected.extend(rng.choice(indices, size=n, replace=False).tolist())
    return adata[np.sort(np.asarray(selected))].copy()


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--config", default=str(ROOT / "config.example.yaml"))
    parser.add_argument("--max-cells-per-type", type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--max-genes", type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--max-spots", type=int, default=None)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    cfg = load_config(Path(args.config))
    data_dir = resolve(cfg["data_dir"])
    results_dir = resolve(cfg["results_dir"])
    results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ref_cfg = dict(cfg["reference"])
    spatial_cfg = dict(cfg["spatial"])
    max_cells = args.max_cells_per_type or int(ref_cfg["max_cells_per_type"])
    max_genes = args.max_genes or int(ref_cfg["max_genes"])
    max_spots = args.max_spots or int(spatial_cfg["max_spots"])

    h5 = data_dir / "V1_Human_Lymph_Node_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"
    ref_path = data_dir / "sc.h5ad"
    if not h5.is_file() or not ref_path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError("run scripts/00_download_data.sh first")
    if not (data_dir / "spatial" / "tissue_positions_list.csv").is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError("spatial/ is missing; extract the 10x spatial tarball")

    print("loading Visium ...", flush=True)
    spatial = sc.read_visium(
        data_dir,
        count_file=h5.name,
        load_images=True,
    )
    spatial.var_names_make_unique()
    spatial.obs["sample"] = "V1_Human_Lymph_Node"
    spatial.var["SYMBOL"] = spatial.var_names.astype(str)
    if "gene_ids" in spatial.var:
        spatial.var.set_index("gene_ids", drop=True, inplace=True)
    mt_genes = remove_mt(spatial)

    rng = np.random.default_rng(int(cfg["seed"]))
    n_spots = min(max_spots, spatial.n_obs)
    keep_spots = np.sort(rng.choice(spatial.n_obs, size=n_spots, replace=False))
    spatial = spatial[keep_spots].copy()

    print("loading scRNA reference ...", flush=True)
    reference = ad.read_h5ad(ref_path)
    reference.var["SYMBOL"] = reference.var_names.astype(str)
    if "GeneID-2" in reference.var:
        reference.var.set_index("GeneID-2", drop=True, inplace=True)
    reference.var_names_make_unique()
    selected = filter_genes(
        reference,
        cell_count_cutoff=5,
        cell_percentage_cutoff2=0.03,
        nonz_mean_cutoff=1.12,
    )
    reference = reference[:, selected].copy()
    reference = stratified_subsample(
        reference,
        "Subset",
        max_cells,
        int(cfg["seed"]),
    )
    for key in ("Subset", "Sample", "Method"):
        if key in reference.obs:
            reference.obs[key] = reference.obs[key].astype(str).astype("category")

    shared = reference.var_names.intersection(spatial.var_names)
    if len(shared) == 0:
        raise ValueError("no shared genes between reference and spatial data")
    if len(shared) > max_genes:
        ref_shared = reference[:, shared].X
        if hasattr(ref_shared, "toarray"):
            n_cells = np.asarray((ref_shared > 0).sum(axis=0)).ravel()
        else:
            n_cells = (ref_shared > 0).sum(axis=0)
        order = np.argsort(n_cells)[::-1][:max_genes]
        shared = shared[order]
    reference = reference[:, shared].copy()
    spatial = spatial[:, shared].copy()

    reference.write_h5ad(results_dir / "prepared_reference.h5ad")
    spatial.write_h5ad(results_dir / "prepared_spatial.h5ad")

    summary = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            ("reference_cells", reference.n_obs),
            ("reference_genes", reference.n_vars),
            ("reference_celltypes", reference.obs["Subset"].nunique()),
            ("spatial_spots", spatial.n_obs),
            ("spatial_genes", spatial.n_vars),
            ("mt_genes_removed", mt_genes),
            ("max_cells_per_type", max_cells),
            ("max_genes", max_genes),
            ("max_spots", max_spots),
        ],
        columns=["metric", "value"],
    )
    summary.to_csv(results_dir / "prepare_summary.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
    print(summary.to_string(index=False), flush=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Train the reference Cell2location RegressionModel on a reduced reference."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import time
from pathlib import Path

import anndata as ad
import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import scvi
import yaml

matplotlib.use("Agg")

from cell2location.models import RegressionModel


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def load_config(path: Path) -> dict:
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return yaml.safe_load(handle)


def resolve(value: str | Path) -> Path:
    path = Path(value)
    return path if path.is_absolute() else ROOT / path


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--config", default=str(ROOT / "config.example.yaml"))
    parser.add_argument("--max-epochs", type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--num-samples", type=int, default=None)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    cfg = load_config(Path(args.config))
    ref_cfg = dict(cfg["reference"])
    results_dir = resolve(cfg["results_dir"])
    ref = ad.read_h5ad(results_dir / "prepared_reference.h5ad")
    epochs = args.max_epochs or int(ref_cfg["max_epochs"])
    batch_size = args.batch_size or int(ref_cfg["batch_size"])
    num_samples = args.num_samples or int(ref_cfg["num_samples"])
    scvi.settings.seed = int(cfg["seed"])
    plt.rcParams["pdf.fonttype"] = 42

    print(
        f"reference: {ref.n_obs} cells x {ref.n_vars} genes; "
        f"celltypes={ref.obs['Subset'].nunique()}; epochs={epochs}",
        flush=True,
    )
    covariates = [
        key for key in ref_cfg.get("categorical_covariates", [])
        if key in ref.obs
    ]
    RegressionModel.setup_anndata(
        adata=ref,
        batch_key="Sample",
        labels_key="Subset",
        categorical_covariate_keys=covariates or None,
    )
    mod = RegressionModel(ref)
    started = time.time()
    mod.train(
        max_epochs=epochs,
        batch_size=batch_size,
        train_size=1,
        accelerator="cpu",
        enable_progress_bar=False,
    )
    elapsed = time.time() - started

    mod.plot_history(5)
    fig = plt.gcf()
    fig.savefig(results_dir / "reference_training_history.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)

    ref = mod.export_posterior(
        ref,
        sample_kwargs={"num_samples": num_samples, "batch_size": batch_size},
    )
    model_dir = results_dir / "reference_model"
    mod.save(str(model_dir), overwrite=True)
    ref.write_h5ad(results_dir / "reference_exported.h5ad")

    factor_names = list(ref.uns["mod"]["factor_names"])
    if "means_per_cluster_mu_fg" in ref.varm:
        columns = [f"means_per_cluster_mu_fg_{name}" for name in factor_names]
        signatures = ref.varm["means_per_cluster_mu_fg"][columns].copy()
    else:
        columns = [f"means_per_cluster_mu_fg_{name}" for name in factor_names]
        signatures = ref.var[columns].copy()
    signatures.columns = factor_names
    signatures.index = ref.var_names
    signatures.to_csv(results_dir / "reference_signatures.tsv", sep="\t")

    pd.DataFrame(
        [
            ("reference_cells", ref.n_obs),
            ("reference_genes", ref.n_vars),
            ("celltypes", len(factor_names)),
            ("epochs", epochs),
            ("batch_size", batch_size),
            ("num_samples", num_samples),
            ("elapsed_seconds", round(elapsed, 2)),
        ],
        columns=["metric", "value"],
    ).to_csv(results_dir / "reference_summary.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
    print(f"reference model done in {elapsed:.1f}s", flush=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Map reference signatures onto Visium spots and render a PDF preview."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import time
from pathlib import Path

import anndata as ad
import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scvi
import yaml

matplotlib.use("Agg")

from cell2location.models import Cell2location


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def load_config(path: Path) -> dict:
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return yaml.safe_load(handle)


def resolve(value: str | Path) -> Path:
    path = Path(value)
    return path if path.is_absolute() else ROOT / path


def abundance_frame(adata: ad.AnnData, key: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if key not in adata.obsm:
        raise KeyError(f"missing obsm[{key!r}]")
    value = adata.obsm[key]
    frame = value.copy() if isinstance(value, pd.DataFrame) else pd.DataFrame(
        value, index=adata.obs_names
    )
    prefix = key.replace("_cell_abundance_w_sf", "cell_abundance_w_sf") + "_"
    if len(frame.columns) and all(str(c).startswith(prefix) for c in frame.columns):
        frame.columns = [str(c)[len(prefix):] for c in frame.columns]
    return frame


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--config", default=str(ROOT / "config.example.yaml"))
    parser.add_argument("--max-epochs", type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--num-samples", type=int, default=None)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    cfg = load_config(Path(args.config))
    spatial_cfg = dict(cfg["spatial"])
    results_dir = resolve(cfg["results_dir"])
    spatial = ad.read_h5ad(results_dir / "prepared_spatial.h5ad")
    signatures = pd.read_csv(results_dir / "reference_signatures.tsv", sep="\t", index_col=0)
    shared = np.intersect1d(spatial.var_names, signatures.index)
    if len(shared) == 0:
        raise ValueError("no shared genes between spatial data and signatures")
    spatial = spatial[:, shared].copy()
    signatures = signatures.loc[shared]
    epochs = args.max_epochs or int(spatial_cfg["max_epochs"])
    num_samples = args.num_samples or int(spatial_cfg["num_samples"])
    scvi.settings.seed = int(cfg["seed"])
    plt.rcParams["pdf.fonttype"] = 42

    print(
        f"spatial: {spatial.n_obs} spots x {spatial.n_vars} genes; "
        f"celltypes={signatures.shape[1]}; epochs={epochs}",
        flush=True,
    )
    Cell2location.setup_anndata(adata=spatial, batch_key="sample")
    mod = Cell2location(
        spatial,
        cell_state_df=signatures,
        N_cells_per_location=float(spatial_cfg["n_cells_per_location"]),
        detection_alpha=float(spatial_cfg["detection_alpha"]),
    )
    started = time.time()
    mod.train(
        max_epochs=epochs,
        batch_size=spatial_cfg.get("batch_size"),
        train_size=1,
        accelerator="cpu",
        enable_progress_bar=False,
    )
    elapsed = time.time() - started
    spatial = mod.export_posterior(
        spatial,
        sample_kwargs={"num_samples": num_samples, "batch_size": spatial.n_obs},
    )
    mod.save(str(results_dir / "spatial_model"), overwrite=True)
    spatial.write_h5ad(results_dir / "sp.h5ad")

    mod.plot_QC()
    fig = plt.gcf()
    fig.savefig(results_dir / "spatial_qc.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)

    means = abundance_frame(spatial, "means_cell_abundance_w_sf").clip(lower=0)
    q05 = abundance_frame(spatial, "q05_cell_abundance_w_sf").clip(lower=0)
    top = means.mean(axis=0).sort_values(ascending=False).head(
        int(spatial_cfg["top_celltypes"])
    ).index.tolist()
    coords = np.asarray(spatial.obsm["spatial"])
    table = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "spot_id": spatial.obs_names.astype(str),
            "x": coords[:, 0],
            "y": coords[:, 1],
        }
    )
    for celltype in top:
        table[f"q05__{celltype}"] = q05[celltype].to_numpy()
    table.to_csv(results_dir / "cell2location_abundance_top.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)

    ncols = 4
    nrows = int(np.ceil(len(top) / ncols))
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(nrows, ncols, figsize=(3.2 * ncols, 3.0 * nrows))
    axes = np.atleast_1d(axes).ravel()
    for ax, celltype in zip(axes, top):
        values = q05[celltype].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        vmax = max(float(np.nanquantile(values, 0.992)), 1e-8)
        scatter = ax.scatter(
            coords[:, 0],
            -coords[:, 1],
            c=values,
            s=5,
            cmap="magma",
            vmin=0,
            vmax=vmax,
            linewidths=0,
        )
        ax.set_title(celltype, fontsize=8)
        ax.set_aspect("equal")
        ax.axis("off")
        fig.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.02, shrink=0.75)
    for ax in axes[len(top):]:
        ax.axis("off")
    fig.suptitle("Cell2location q05 cell abundance (reduced CPU run)", fontsize=11)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(results_dir / "fig_cell2location_spatial.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)

    pd.DataFrame(
        [
            ("spatial_spots", spatial.n_obs),
            ("spatial_genes", spatial.n_vars),
            ("celltypes", signatures.shape[1]),
            ("epochs", epochs),
            ("num_samples", num_samples),
            ("elapsed_seconds", round(elapsed, 2)),
            ("top_celltypes", ", ".join(top)),
        ],
        columns=["metric", "value"],
    ).to_csv(results_dir / "spatial_summary.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
    print(f"spatial mapping done in {elapsed:.1f}s", flush=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Regenerate training-history and mapping-QC PDFs from saved models."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import anndata as ad
import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

matplotlib.use("Agg")

from cell2location.models import Cell2location, RegressionModel


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RESULTS = ROOT / "results"


def main() -> int:
    plt.rcParams["pdf.fonttype"] = 42
    ref = ad.read_h5ad(RESULTS / "prepared_reference.h5ad")
    reference_model = RegressionModel.load(str(RESULTS / "reference_model"), ref)
    reference_model.plot_history(5)
    plt.gcf().savefig(
        RESULTS / "reference_training_history.pdf",
        bbox_inches="tight",
    )
    plt.close()

    spatial = ad.read_h5ad(RESULTS / "sp.h5ad")
    spatial_model = Cell2location.load(str(RESULTS / "spatial_model"), spatial)
    spatial = spatial_model.export_posterior(
        spatial,
        sample_kwargs={"num_samples": 20, "batch_size": spatial.n_obs},
    )
    spatial_model.plot_QC()
    plt.gcf().savefig(RESULTS / "spatial_qc.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close()
    print("QC PDFs regenerated")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
